instruction: Design a system that combines the shift register module and the adder-subtractor module. The system should take in two 4-bit inputs (a and b) and perform addition or subtraction based on a select input. The output should be the result of the operation, along with an overflow signal indicating whether the result is greater than 15 or less than 0. The system should include an additional functional module that takes in the shift register output and the result of the operation and outputs the bitwise OR of the two.
label: trojan
